qAndA.answer: The solutions are found on the subpages of the 'Problems' section.

qAndA.answer: The site appears to incorporate elements of Theory of Knowledge, Nature of Science, and International Mindedness, suggesting a holistic approach to lesson planning beyond just subject matter.

The explanation of optional practical work and tests could be more concise, especially since these features are self-explanatory within the context of the website.

text_to_speech: the thing I be physics site is organized to help you plan lessons step 1 choose whether the topic you're teaching is standard level core additional higher level or an option topic the subfolders each represent approximately one to two lessons for example specific heat capacity and latent heat within thermal physics the lesson hub page gives the key aims and some concise suggestions about how to incorporate theory of knowledge nature of science or international mindedness you will find the resources in the navigation pane to the left in the following order activities or problem-based learning required practical work with teacher notes multiple choice questions problems with accompanying solutions on their sub pages optional practical work and a test
